Test-only change.

raw_graphql_pull_request.title: [Test] managers: Give the chunked-abort test scheduler an output_streamer

detail.body:
- `test_scheduler_chunked_abort_race.py`'s fake scheduler now always carries an `output_streamer` mock, set once in `_make_scheduler` instead of in one test. `send_abort_output` calls `output_streamer.release_detokenize_state` since #47260, and `test_aborted_chunked_beam_leader_retires_its_group` (added in #47381, which merged right after) built its scheduler without one, so it fails on main.

Test-only change.
